name: VacuumTube
description: VacuumTube uses electron-updater's checkForUpdatesAndNotify after startup and configures the shy1132/VacuumTube GitHub publisher for Windows and macOS artifacts. The reviewed package configuration has no explicit code-signing or notarization setting; electron-updater's SHA-512 behavior is dependency-provided and not independently established here.
limitations: Newly retrieved default-branch snapshot, not the original study checkout; release artifacts and builder environment are not audited.
electron-updater internals and generated latest.yml/SHA-512 metadata were not part of review, so SHA-512 enforcement remains dependency-level evidence only.
